_comment: OPTIONAL — only if you want to offload cheap/long-context work to Gemini to save Claude quota. Needs a free Gemini API key from AI Studio (aistudio.google.com). Install Claude Code Router: npm i -g @musistudio/claude-code-router, put this at ~/.claude-code-router/config.json, then launch with `ccr code` instead of `claude`.
_important: Do NOT route `default` to Gemini — that is where Claude Code applies edits, and non-Claude diffs fail against its edit format. Keep coding, edits, and review on Claude.
